label: Second-lift completion
title: Rule32's inherited second-lift tuples close at radius one through depth two
summary: Across H128/H160, K/O and depths 0–2, the inherited Rule32 pair family fails at radius 0 and closes at radius 1; all 36 full-four-symbol ambient controls fail through radius 2. The represented alphabet grows while the inherited minimum cap radius stays one.
takeaway: The correction construction can be applied a second time with bounded local closure on its inherited family, but the added resource is product-alphabet correction state on the same 1D lattice, not a new spatial axis.
